title: A GUN DRAGS BACK TO ITS KEY
why: From the review of the four-gun belt, build 5. A gun in his hands always shows on a gun key as well (his v15.25 note: key 1 never goes black while he holds a gun), so after he dragged the rifle from key 1 to key 6, key 1 still showed it. Dragging it from key 6 back onto key 1 was taken as a drop on its own key: nothing changed, nothing was said, and key 6 and his belt plan kept the rifle. Now the drag back takes it off key 6, pins it on key 1 like any gun dropped on a gun key, and the line names the key.
now: A gun put on a later key drags back onto the gun key that shows it.
